title: Kaili language - Wikipedia
text: Kaili is an Austronesian dialect cluster of the Celebic branch, and is one of the principal languages of Central Sulawesi. The heartland of the Kaili area is the broad Palu River valley which stretches southward from Central Sulawesi's capital city, Palu.

title: Kaili, Unde Language (UNZ) – L1 & L2 Speakers... | Ethnologue Free
text: Unde Kaili is a stable indigenous language of Indonesia. It belongs to the Austronesian language family. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by all in the ethnic community.

title: Kaili Unde in Indonesia people group profile | Joshua Project
text: The Kaili Unde live in small villages often comprised of houses on stilts. The coastal Kaili Unde earn a living through hillside agriculture, as well as copra, cacao and palm plantations.

title: Who are the Kaili Unde? - Praying for Indonesia
text: Kaili Unde The Kaili Unde live in the mountainous western side of Palu Bay in Central Sulawesi. Some of the Kaili Unde also inhabit the southern part of Donggala and across the mountains to the coast. The word unde means “no.”
